messages:
emma-support: Heads-up — Acme support ticket: p99 latency for /v1/generate jumped to ~2.8s from 0.9s starting ~01:30 UTC, multiple timeouts. Customer impacted. Request ids: r=3e9a, r=3e9b.
oliver: digging in. any recent rollouts or model swaps around that window?
deploy-bot: deploy success: graphql-service v2.14.0 @ 2026-03-16T01:25:12Z (sha: a1b2c3)
jamie-sre: I see a rollout to a new batching policy on runtime-proxy at 01:24 UTC — changed max_batch_ms from 12 -> 40 to improve throughput. Could explain higher tail.
sri: pulling p95/p99 graphs now. @jamie-sre can you check routing rules? are fallback-models or region routing changed?
jamie-sre: routing unchanged. however batch windows increased -> higher head-of-line and some requests hitting CPU scheduling on smaller GPU instances. p50 unaffected, p99 jumped.
natalie-pm: Customer SLAs say 500ms p95 for this endpoint. They are pushing for hotfix.
liam-oncall: mitigation plan proposal: 1) rollback batching policy to previous value, 2) temporarily enable stricter rate limiting per-tenant to protect cluster, 3) enable fast-fallback to smaller model variant in eu-west for Acme-only if latency > 1.2s. Thoughts?
emma-support: please do. Customer is already experiencing degraded UX. priority: hotfix then postmortem.
jamie-sre: executing rollback now: `kubectl set env deploy/runtime-proxy MAX_BATCH_MS=12 -n prod`
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: runtime-proxy rollout @ 2026-03-16T01:40:05Z (change: MAX_BATCH_MS)
oliver: rolling out tenant-rate-limit: acme-org -> 30 rps per key for 10m as circuit-breaker pad. Command: `rbctl apply -f acme-throttle.yaml`
sri: enabling model fallback policy for acme org: route to model-compact-v2 if p95 > 1200ms. TTL 15m. Command: `redwood route set --tenant acme --fallback model-compact-v2 --threshold 1200ms`
liam-oncall: monitoring dashboards: p99 started falling at 01:42 UTC. current p99 ~1.1s; p95 ~430ms. Still watching for regressions.
emma-support: Customer notified about temporary throttling + fallback, offered credits. They accepted hotfix.
natalie-pm: keep me posted — we'll need a write-up for the account team and incident blameless postmortem.
jamie-sre: action items logged: (1) revert batching policy (done), (2) tenant throttle applied (30rps), (3) fallback routed (model-compact-v2), (4) capture perf traces and KV cache hit rates for 01:00-02:00 UTC.
oliver: follow-up: propose smarter autoscaling thresholds for small GPU flavors and a preflight check for batch-window changes in canary. Adding to backlog.
liam-oncall: closing mitigation loop in 30m if stable. tagging @pagerduty on-call for visibility. :thumbsup:
emma-support: thanks team — customer says experience improving. will reopen if they see more issues.
